newsitem.title: JAPAN: Janome says will keep selling "24-hour" bath units.
newsitem.headline: Janome says will keep selling "24-hour" bath units.

text.p: Janome Sewing Machine Co Ltd said on Monday that it would continue selling its "24-hour bath" units despite some concerns over their safety.
The popular bath unit circulates water in the system so that the tub is filled with fresh warm water round the clock.
But shares in Janome, a top maker of the product, were hit hard on Monday by reports that some companies had suspended sales of the product.

An official at the Ministry of International Trade and Industry said earlier on Monday that Inax Corp, Sekisui Chemical Co Ltd and Hitachi Chemical Co Ltd had suspended sales of "24-hour bath" units after the ministry asked them to check the products' safety.
Janome shares closed down 80 yen, or 26.67 percent, at 220 on Monday, the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"We believe our products are concerned with safety and hygene and we deal sincerely with our consumers," Janome said in a statement.
The MITI official said the ministry had informed companies in December that it was concerned that a pneumonia-causing bacterium, legionella pneumophila, could grow in the system.
